resolution_notes: docs_url: incorrect original (HTTP 404). Current official API docs at https://launchdarkly.com/docs/api (and https://apidocs.launchdarkly.com/). Verifier B correction adopted. cors: Verifier B claim of browser CORS support not confirmed in public docs; REST control-plane is server-side with API tokens. No official CORS policy found; keep original "unknown" (conservative). Evidence: launchdarkly.com/docs/api, launchdarkly.com/docs/home/getting-started/api-access-tokens.
